kind: post-hoc comparability check of the 40 production run inputs (md.tpr) and the equilibration/production parameter files, before any ABL-MYR-1b protocol is written. No trajectory is opened, no descriptor computed, no condition difference in dynamics scored
relation_to_earlier: ABL-MYR-1 (blocked at G1) and ABL-MYR-1a (initialization audit, verdict V4_set1_comparability_failed) are preserved unchanged and remain valid. This check does not overturn V4: V4 states that the ORIGINAL G4 identity rules fail. This check gathers comparability evidence under new, explicitly post-hoc criteria, so that a separate ABL-MYR-1b protocol can be written only if they pass
already_seen_before_this_freeze: ABL-MYR-1a results: system.gro/system_em.gro protein comparisons, the differing production_md.mdp lines (compressed-x-grps, tc_grps naming MYRP), the topol.top water counts (29949 vs 29938), md.tpr topology digests, residue counts per md.tpr, and the flag that MDAnalysis returns md.tpr positions. NOT seen: any md.tpr coordinate or velocity value, nvt.mdp, npt.mdp, index.ndx contents

inputs.archive_hashes: sizes and SHA-256 of ABL-MYR-1/run_spec.json re-verified first
inputs.extraction_dir: benchmarks/audit/abl_myr_1/data_dryad/extracted_1b/ (git-ignored), with the frozen ABL-MYR-1 resolver and traversal-safe extractor

tools.gromacs: not installed (no gmx, gmx_mpi or gmx_d; no package manager available); gmx dump/check cannot be used
tools.tpr_reader: MDAnalysis 2.10.0 (positions, velocities if present, box, bonds, charges, masses, residue names)
tools.independent_validation: (a) atom order: the full-system atom-name sequence of each md.tpr equals that of the same-set, same-condition system_em.gro parsed as text by the frozen runner's parser; (b) physics: every protein bond of the tpr bond list has a minimum-image length in [0.9, 2.3] Å; (c) cross-file geometry: the md.tpr Cα trace, made whole along the chain by minimum image, superposes on the text-parsed system_em.gro Cα trace (made whole the same way) with Cα RMSD <= 1.0 Å. The Kabsch superposition is implemented here in NumPy (SVD), independent of the MDAnalysis reader. Basis for (c): the eLife Methods restrain backbone heavy atoms (1000 kJ/mol/nm^2) during the 0.1 ns NVT and 1 ns NPT equilibration between minimization and production

do_not: Set2 system_em.gro is used only as the validation reference for Set2 run inputs, never as a production start

questions.R1_usable_coordinates: Do the 40 md.tpr files provide usable production-start coordinates? Per run: positions finite and box present; validation (a), (b), (c)
questions.R2_production_start_geometry: Per run: Cα RMSD to its system_em.gro reference, Cα radius of gyration, box volume, velocities present. Pairwise Cα and protein heavy-atom RMSD after optimal superposition, separately for: within condition (per set, 45 pairs per condition), between conditions (per set, 100 pairs), and Set1 vs Set2 within a condition (100 pairs). Counts of pairs below 0.01 Å Cα RMSD; distinct velocity sets
questions.R3_tc_groups: Which atoms each production tc-grps group contains (index.ndx groups mapped onto the md.tpr atom order): residue composition, whether the groups partition the system
questions.R4_thermostat_and_coupling: For nvt.mdp, npt.mdp and production_md.mdp in each set: every key compared between conditions; ref_t of every group; tau_t, tcoupl, pcoupl and all other keys; stated initialization (gen_vel, gen_seed, gen_temp, continuation, define)
questions.R5_composition: From every md.tpr: complete residue-name counts (protein, ligands, solvent, ions), atom count, net charge (sum of charges, e)
questions.R6_classification: Every observed difference between conditions classified as inherent to the Myr model, potential confound, or not separable from Myr presence (rules below)

rules.mdp_value_equivalence: two values are equal if identical after whitespace normalization; a difference is 'inherent_group_name' if removing every 'MYRP' component from the underscore-joined group tokens of the Myr value yields the noMyr value; any other difference is a 'potential_confound'
rules.tc_group_content: each tc group of production_md.mdp must exist in index.ndx; the groups must partition all atoms (no atom twice, none missing); the coupling group of the solute may contain only protein residues, ATP, MG and (Myr condition only) MYRP; the solvent group only SOL, NA and CL
rules.composition: residue-name counts must be identical between conditions except MYRP (present only with Myr) and SOL (|difference| <= 1 % of the noMyr count); |net charge difference| <= 0.5 e

inherent_to_Myr_model: MYRP present only in the Myr system
group names differing only by MYRP
SOL count difference within 1 % (the solvent fills the volume the Myr does not occupy)
potential_confound: any ion or other residue count difference
a net charge difference above 0.5 e
a tc group content outside the rule
not_separable_from_Myr_presence: differences between Myr and noMyr production-start geometries: both conditions are equilibrated with or without Myr bound, so such differences are not attributed to Myr and are not called confounds

criteria_all_required.K1_usable_coordinates: all 40 md.tpr: finite positions and a box; validations (a), (b) and (c) pass for every run
criteria_all_required.K2_thermostat_comparable: for every mdp file type and set: no potential_confound difference; every ref_t value equals 300; the number of tc groups equal between conditions
criteria_all_required.K3_tc_groups: the tc group content rule holds for every set and condition
criteria_all_required.K4_composition: the composition rule holds in both sets
criteria_all_required.K5_replicates_not_copies: within each set and condition, the 10 production starts are not all copies: they comprise at least 2 distinct starts (Cα RMSD > 0.01 Å), or velocities are available and not all identical

descriptive_only: R2 within- vs between-condition RMSD distributions (no threshold, no test)

outcome.comparable_for_1b: K1-K5 all pass. A separate ABL-MYR-1b protocol may then be written and hash-frozen before any trajectory is opened
outcome.not_comparable: any criterion fails: stop and report the failing criteria. No threshold is relaxed afterwards

stop_conditions.S1: an archive size or SHA-256 differs from ABL-MYR-1/run_spec.json
stop_conditions.S2: a member is missing or matches more than once
stop_conditions.S3: an mdp, ndx, top or gro file cannot be parsed (an unreadable md.tpr is a K1 failure, not a stop)
stop_conditions.S4: the extracted size or CPU budget is exceeded

interpretation_limits: shared start means: both conditions derive from identical pre-minimization protein coordinates (ABL-MYR-1a Q1, Q4) and, if K1-K5 pass, comparable run inputs; production starts are post-equilibration and differ by the equilibration of each system
no causal Myr claim; nothing about Ayaz WT/M472I, HDX, drug response or biological function
